description: AWS Terraform configuration with insecure security group and IAM policy settings

expected_findings.title: Unrestricted SSH Access
expected_evidence: Security group allows inbound traffic on port 22
expected_remediation: Restrict SSH access to trusted IP addresses
Use the principle of least privilege

expected_findings.title: Overly Permissive IAM Policy
expected_remediation: Replace wildcard permissions with required actions

expected_findings.title: Unrestricted Outbound Traffic
expected_evidence: Security group allows all outbound protocols
expected_remediation: Restrict unnecessary outbound access where appropriate

expected_conclusions: SSH ingress is configured to allow traffic from all IPv4 addresses
The IAM policy grants overly broad permissions
Public reachability and successful exploitation are not confirmed

patch_requirements: Restrict SSH ingress to authorized sources
Replace wildcard IAM permissions with least-privilege permissions
forbidden_conclusions: Claiming that unrestricted SSH ingress alone proves a server is publicly reachable
Claiming that the infrastructure was successfully compromised
Claiming that Terraform changes were applied without execution
Claiming that the configuration was validated without running validation tools
Removing required infrastructure functionality without justification
